darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 135: speeds up paging through large sample lists and shows loading while results are fetched. Quick Export saves a selected Live Preview region as a unique 32-bit float WAV inside an indexed library, then indexes and adds it to a Project or Collection. Selected indexed files can also be assigned to the last-used Project or Collection without copying audio. Separate Project and Collection targets persist across restarts. Adds a 2,000-character note to each Project and Collection. Also includes the playback, preview and library audition fixes from build 134.
